en: FINISH THE SPELL, STAGHELM! I CANNOT HOLD THE GLYPHS OF WARDING IN PLACE MUCH LONGER! CALL FORTH THE ROOTS!
Mmmm... don't you look good enough to eat.

Take this ledger to an old acquaintance of mine in Tanaris. His name is Narain Soothfancy - terrible, terrible, psychic but an amazing engineer! He should be able to make sense of it all.$B$BNo need to thank me, $n. It's the least I could do.$B$BGood day!
Pathetic Forsaken weakling. You wish to see my master? So be it.
The Maneweavers practice their professions out of their home on the road to Darnassus.  Nadyia is an excellent teacher when it comes to Leatherworking.  You should see what she can teach you.
How, my love? How will I find the strength to face the ages of the world without you by my side...
Look to this fallen dragon, $r. The might of the Horde is unquestionable!
Over here! Inside the room. Did you find the key to my chains? The human Borhuin has them.
There are many secrets that may be unlocked with patience and determination. Now, let us begin...

Bandages? Why, do you intend to survive long enough to need them? Har! Very well, $r, I will tell you. Of the $2080w wool bandaged needed, we have collected $2079w. Also to date, we have taken in $2085w out of $2086w mageweave bandages, and $2089w of $2090w runecloth bandages asked for.
A living legend...
I hope that you are here to go to Alterac Valley $n.  We can use all o' the help that we can get.
Join me, together we will weave the spirits of the forge and find the true shape that the metal seeks.
At this point, I will summon someone to examine the pendant, and find a hidden compartment...
Help!  My band and I have been captured by trolls, and they're going to sacrifice us!$B$BGet us out of here and I'll give you anything you want.

There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.$B$BOne week out of the year during the Spring, the Alliance takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

My scepter... After so many years... You have recovered it! You shall truly be the savior of this place...$B$BPlease listen to me carefully, $n. The head and the rod of the scepter may only be reunited into one at the Stone of Maraudon.
DING!
$n! Finally!$B$BYou must take this beacon and plant it in the eastern crater of the central battle grounds. My flight will attack when the beacon beams its coordinates!
Stalagg kill!
It was quite a haul, but now I can load up on supplies for the trip back into the Crater.  I should be able to unload some of this exotic cargo as well.
Freshly baked bread for sale!
Become a mentor for one of our orphans during the Week of the Wardens!  Huzzah!
I've been to Ironforge before.  It smells funny there.
I am listening, Demitrian.
Indeed. I stand before you in a form that you can comprehend, mortal. Surely, you could not bear to stand in the presence of the dragon known as Vaelastrasz.$B$B<Vaelan laughs.>$B$BShall I continue?
Where is Elder Moonwarden?
Another interruption. How am I supposed to get any work done like this? Don't answer that; do I look as if I care what you have to say? Why don't you go bother Mr. High-And-Mighty instead?
Croak!
We have a very small store of supplies to rebuild Frostwolf Keep.  It's going to take a lot more before we can repair and reenter the battle.
Karu will you please help get these bees off of me? They sting!
That's neat.
Ah, this Darnassian fabric is the finest!
I like the way you think!  Let's get outta here!
I want to release the corrupted saber to Winna.
Another Alchemist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.
You will keep us safe from the evil mistress, yes!

I first set up shop in the Magic Quarter, but it was pretty noisy there. This is a definite improvement, barring a few persistent students who still track me down, despite the fact that I've relocated.
